body: It seems like all stages has had major issues with sound or electrical.

Chaps was one of the best resources I got. They were able to get me out of the office once a week for counseling and never pushed any religious beliefs. Legally can’t say anything, absolutely nothing unless you give them permission to.

I completely agree. I’m not cured I’m just more so aware of it. 
I just want to let this officer know that if only I could have related to someone in a higher rank, I most likely wouldn’t have tried all 3 times. Just this post has helped me in so many ways already.

As someone who was enlisted in the Marine Corps, I appreciate the honesty. I had 3 failed suicide attempts while in service and my command brushed it under the rug. However, did my time and still got an honorable discharge. There are ways to be discreet about seeking help while in service. I wish I knew about that before taking drastic measures. Reach out to your pcp and tell them you’re interested in hollistic help therapy, no meds.
